title: Stabilization of a Simple Pendulum at Multiple Equilibria using PD Control
expert_review: An excellent problem that integrates nonlinear dynamics, control design, linearization, and stability analysis. It moves beyond simple set-point stabilization to consider multiple equilibria, which is a key concept in nonlinear control. The solution requires careful algebraic manipulation and a deep understanding of how linear control affects nonlinear system behavior.
source: Based on standard nonlinear control textbook problem (e.g., similar to Section 5.5 of a typical text)
learning_objectives: Derive the closed-loop dynamics of a nonlinear system under linear state feedback.
Verify equilibrium conditions for a nonlinear closed-loop system.
Linearize a nonlinear state-space model about a given equilibrium point.
Derive transfer functions from linearized state-space models.
Determine stability conditions for second-order linear systems.
Synthesize controller gain constraints to achieve stability at multiple operating points of a nonlinear plant.
